turns.assessment: The local critical EQPT_TX_FAIL on trx.och35.a coincides with loss of och35 at the far-end receiver and at every downstream channel monitor from S24 through S21. Unchanged amplifier telemetry and unaffected reverse-direction reception argue against a span, amplifier, or whole-card failure. This is the signature of the och35 transmitter laser failing at S08.

proposals.rationale: The explicit transmitter-failure alarm at this interface is simultaneous with far-end OCH_LOS and loss of this channel at every downstream OCM. The local receive-side metrics remain normal, consistent with a transmit-only laser failure.
A card failure could remove the transmitted channel, but it should also disrupt the unit's receive traffic and monitoring; those metrics showed no change.
A ROADM failure at S08 could block the outgoing signal, but it does not explain the interface's explicit EQPT_TX_FAIL and would commonly affect additional channels on the failed port.
